go_ahead.text: la phase 1 de gateway-releases est finie, fais sa review de clôture. Je valide le coût d'avance.

status.note: usage.py estimate --start refused the verifiers' wave at 92% of the window, 2026-10-31 12:40; the review resumes at its verification, under the go-ahead it has

findings.title: prune keeps v99 and removes v100: the releases are sorted as text
findings.cause: releases sorts the directory names as strings, and releases_to_prune trusts that order
findings.consequence: with v99, v100 and v263 installed and v263 current, `gateway prune --keep 1` removes v100 and keeps v99
findings.fix: releases parses each name and sorts the releases by number
findings.test: releases_come_by_number on v99, v100 and v263; prune_goes_by_release_number
findings.evidence: reproduced: in review-correctness's copy, releases_come_by_number and prune_goes_by_release_number red on the order

findings.title: a data directory whose path holds a space makes prune remove other directories
findings.cause: remove runs `sh -c "rm -rf <dir>"` with the path unquoted
findings.consequence: with XDG_DATA_HOME at `/home/me/My Data`, prune runs `rm -rf /home/me/My` and a relative `Data/ai-ctl/llama-swap/v262`
findings.fix: the release renamed out of sight, then removed with remove_dir_all, as FsBuildStore::remove does
findings.evidence: reproduced: in review-correctness's copy, a_removal_under_a_path_with_a_space_removes_the_release_alone red, the directory beside removed; review-security's gate: the variable is the user's own, no boundary crossed, so a bug and not a security finding

findings.title: a failed removal is reported as done
findings.cause: remove ignores the command's status and returns Ok
findings.consequence: a release that stays is printed as removed, and its megabytes as freed
findings.fix: the removal's error returned, with the path
findings.evidence: read: remove's body; reproduced: rm on a read-only parent, Ok returned

findings.title: a name that is not UTF-8 makes releases panic
findings.consequence: a directory named with a byte that is not UTF-8 makes `gateway prune` panic
findings.fix: such a name skipped: it is no release of ai-ctl's
findings.test: releases_come_by_number with a name that is not UTF-8

findings.title: presentation imports infrastructure::paths
findings.cause: run reads the releases' directory with Paths::from_env for its message
findings.consequence: the layer rule broken: presentation never imports infrastructure
findings.fix: the directory passed through Services by main.rs

findings.title: releases_to_prune copies to_prune's selection
findings.cause: the same skip-the-newest, keep-the-current selection written twice
findings.consequence: a change to the rule must be made twice
findings.fix: one generic selection over an order, shared by both
findings.test: none: the domain tests of both cover it

findings.title: newest is called nowhere
findings.cause: written for a later `gateway install --installed` that no phase plans
findings.consequence: code to read and keep with no caller
findings.evidence: read: a search for `newest(` finds its definition alone
findings.fingerprint: dead and legacy code | src/domain/gateway.rs | newest

findings.title: the `clean` alias is kept for llm-ctl's habit, with no obligation
findings.consequence: a second name for the command, documented nowhere
findings.evidence: read: the attribute and its comment
findings.fingerprint: dead and legacy code | src/presentation/cli.rs | GatewayAction::Prune

findings.title: a comment in French
findings.cause: the comment on the current release
findings.consequence: CLAUDE.md asks every comment in English

findings.title: the reads of releases and size fail without their path
findings.cause: `?` without `.context()` on read_dir's entries, on size's read_dir and on its reads
findings.consequence: a release that cannot be read fails prune with `Permission denied (os error 13)` alone
findings.fix: each read with the path in its context
findings.evidence: read: the three lines; CLAUDE.md, Errors

findings.title: the tests let the ordering bug through
findings.cause: the use case's test checks is_ok alone, the domain test uses three-digit releases only, and the store's releases, size and remove have no test
findings.consequence: finding 1 passes every test; 15 of the diff's 25 mutants are missed
findings.fix: tests on the use case's result, on releases of one, two and three digits, and on the store's three methods
findings.fingerprint: tests | src/application/gateway.rs + src/domain/gateway.rs + src/infrastructure/gateway_store.rs | FsGatewayStore::releases + tests::prune_keeps_the_newest_releases_and_the_current_one + tests::prune_removes_old_releases

findings.title: size reads each file whole to count its bytes
findings.cause: fs::read where the file's metadata gives its length
findings.consequence: about 43 MB read for each release removed, a fraction of a second
findings.fix: the length from each entry's metadata

findings.title: gateway prune is missing from docs/commands.md
findings.cause: the README alone was changed, though the phase's last task says both
findings.consequence: the reference lists no `gateway prune`, nor the lock it takes
findings.fix: the command's row, section and locks in docs/commands.md
findings.evidence: read: docs/commands.md and the phase file's task
findings.fingerprint: the CLI's contract | docs/commands.md + src/presentation/cli.rs | Concurrency + GatewayAction::Prune + command table + gateway

findings.title: prune neither holds the gateway's lock nor spares the release the running gateway runs
findings.cause: build prune takes the gateway's lock and refuses a build the gateway serves; gateway prune does neither
findings.consequence: prune removes the binary a running gateway runs, and a gateway can start on a release being removed
findings.fix: prune takes the gateway's lock and fails, removing nothing, when the running gateway runs a release to remove
findings.evidence: reproduced: in review-correctness's copy, prune removes v262 under a FakeGateway whose record runs it

findings.title: a failed removal does not name the releases removed before it
findings.cause: prune returns the removal's error as it is, where build prune's names what is gone
findings.consequence: after a failure the user cannot tell which releases are gone
findings.fix: the error names the releases removed before it, as build prune's does

findings.title: the releases' lock says `installing` while prune holds it
findings.cause: lock writes the activity `installing llama-swap` whoever takes it
findings.consequence: an install during a prune fails with `another ai-ctl is installing llama-swap`
findings.fix: the holder's activity passed to lock, a change of the port
findings.evidence: read: lock and its two callers

findings.title: a symlinked release directory makes prune remove its target
findings.cause: releases lists a link named like a release, and remove runs rm -rf on it
findings.consequence: a link `v100 -> ~/work` would have prune remove ~/work
